notes: Encoded ONLY from the Noble page; no Lochinvar-family file was used as a source, no usesStylesOf is set, and nothing in this file changes any Lochinvar-family file. The page states the parent is Lochinvar, a subsidiary of A.O. Smith since 2011. Styles 1 and 7 are held: both encode year in letters whose mapping lives only in chart images. Styles 3, 4, 5, and 6 ship year-only: year = 1st-2nd digits per page text (sliced as characters 2-3, which agree with digit counting in every example), while month = 1st letter per page text with its mapping only in chart images, so month is null. Style 2 ships year + week; styles 8 and 9 ship year + month, all from page text.

styles.era: Used 2011 to present; 4 digits + letter + 6 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial 11 42N012345. Year = 1st-2nd positions (11 = 2011), week = 3rd-4th positions (42).

Page example serial J-930001. Year = 1st-2nd digits (93 = 1993), sliced as characters 2-3. Month = 1st letter per page text but its mapping lives only in chart images, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

styles.era: Used 1978 to present; letter + 2 digits + letter + 8 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial A 07H00123456. Year = 1st-2nd digits (07 = 2007), sliced as characters 2-3. Month = 1st letter per page text but its mapping lives only in chart images, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

styles.era: Used 1974 to 1997 with Standard Hi-Power and Oil Fired BRE Series models; letter + 6 digits + letter
styles.notes: Page example serial J 93-1030F. Year = 1st-2nd digits (93 = 1993), sliced as characters 2-3. Month = 1st letter per page text but its mapping lives only in chart images, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

styles.era: Used 1965 through 1986 with HF, G-O, and PG series models; letter + 5 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial M 78013. Year = 1st-2nd digits (78 = 1978), sliced as characters 2-3. Month = 1st letter per page text but its mapping lives only in chart images, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

styles.era: Used 1978 through 2010 with Electric Boosters (SB) series; always 10 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial 12345697 08. Year = 7th-8th digits (97 = 1997), month = 9th-10th digits (08 = August).

styles.era: Used 1984 through present with HF, G-O, and PG series models; always 8 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial 85 041234. Year = 1st-2nd digits (85 = 1985), month = 3rd-4th digits (04 = April).
